The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) confirmed the start of the rainy season on June 2 after several days of widespread rainfall brought by the habagat or southwest monsoon. Yet while the rains have arrived, so too have the familiar risks – torrential rain, flooding, landslides, and, too often, avoidable tragedy.
